name: mantaprint-hub
changelog: Drivers & devices: steps that need several files (HP plugin .asc + .run, HP LaserJet .dl per model, ScanSnap .nal per scanner) show one row per file with its own upload button and a check mark once it is on the hub.
Fix: uploading the HPLIP plugin's .asc signature before the .run failed with 'Upload failed' (its folder did not exist yet).
Fix: uploading the HPLIP plugin hung at 'Checking file' forever (hp-plugin's license prompt looped on a closed stdin); hp-plugin now runs under a pseudo-terminal as a background job with a live log.
